answer: Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. One name, one proof, one entry: Verified dry stone waller licence with dry stone wallers association confirmation enforces it, and a licence wallers renew after wall audits is how the check runs. Trying costs a waiting period of 7 days that no payment can shorten a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. Every sparrow is counted once. The grove is checked, not assumed. The juniper is on the docket.
